name: branding-coffee-roaster-identity-with-orange-panels-and-outline-mascot
title: Orange and cream coffee-roaster identity across Instagram-style cards: poster in a photo, pouch, wordmark panel and outline mascot
whatItIs: A black board with six Instagram-style cards: a photo of a person on white tiles beside an orange framed poster with a mascot and contact info, a cream pouch with 'BOMBA' and a tag, a full orange card with a big cream wordmark, an orange card 'THAT FIRST SIP.' with a large outline mascot, coffee beans with sticker-like mascots and a cream card 'WE'RE OPEN' with mascots.
whatItMeans: Warm and friendly; an outline mascot on orange makes a coffee brand instantly recognisable.
techniques: Draw a mascot in cream outline on orange.
Use big cream wordmarks on flat orange.
Give the mascot sticker outlines over photos.

vocabulary.definition: A character drawn in a single-colour outline.
A thick border making an illustration look like a sticker.
A post filled with one brand colour.
